metricsBox.title: 📊 AT A GLANCE: THE ROI METRICS

sections.heading: The Overview
paragraphs: A leading Sports Medicine and Rehabilitation clinic in Fremont, CA, partnered with Growlimo to improve the quality of their digital patient leads. While they were getting traffic, their previous agency delivered a high volume of unqualified clicks. They needed a strategic Google Ads overhaul to capture dedicated athletes and patients requiring specialized physical therapy.

sections.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Before Growlimo took over, the clinic's marketing faced several bottlenecks:
bullets: Low Lead Quality: Ads triggered for general fitness queries rather than clinical sports injury treatments, causing massive drop-offs at the front desk.
High CPA on Generic Terms: Budget was consumed by competitive, generic keywords that didn't convert into actual clinic visits.

sections.heading: The Growlimo Strategy
paragraphs: We rebuilt their patient acquisition funnel from the ground up, focusing strictly on high-intent sports medicine search queries in the Bay Area.
bullets: Intent-Based Keyword Silos: We isolated campaigns into specific injury categories, targeting keywords like 'ACL rehab clinic,' 'sports chiropractor near me,' and 'rotator cuff physical therapy.'

Enhanced Lead Filtering: We rewrote ad copy to explicitly state that the clinic offered medical rehabilitation, actively deterring non-clinical fitness searchers. These healthcare advertising solutions are part of our core methodology.

sections.heading: The Results (90-Day Sprint)
paragraphs: Over a 90-day period, Growlimo stabilized their lead flow, dramatically increased the qualification rate, and turned their ad spend into a highly profitable revenue engine. Our Physio Google Ads expansion is another example of our success.
sections.closing: By prioritizing lead quality over sheer click volume, Growlimo helped this Fremont Sports & Rehab clinic maximize their $9,100 ad spend, resulting in 150 new dedicated patients.
